sources.snippet: Qwen3-1.7B-Base Qwen3-1.7B-Base is a 1.7 billion parameter causal language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released in July 2025. It is a base (pretrained) model trained on 36 trillion tokens across 119 languages, featuring a 32k token context window and designed for inference efficiency on resource-constrained setups.
